columns.name: carrier_account
columns.reason: The carrier account billed for the return is set when the return shipment is booked, after the claim is raised.

columns.name: smart_health_index
columns.reason: SMART-derived health score is read off the drive before the claim is filed.

columns.name: controller_type
columns.reason: Static hardware attribute of the installed drive.

columns.name: erase_method
columns.reason: The sanitisation actually performed is recorded during return handling, after the claim.

columns.name: firmware_rev
columns.reason: Firmware revision running on the drive is known at the time of failure.

columns.name: interface_type
columns.reason: Static hardware attribute of the drive.

columns.name: qa_sample_flag
columns.reason: Ambiguous: could be a manufacturing QA sample marker on the unit or QA sampling of the return after intake.

columns.name: test_bench_id
columns.reason: The bench test documenting the failure normally precedes the claim, though a depot re-test would not.

columns.name: warranty_tier
columns.reason: Contractual coverage tier is on file for the asset before the claim.

columns.name: return_freight_usd
columns.reason: Freight cost is only incurred once the return is authorised and shipped.

columns.name: inbound_dock
columns.reason: Recorded when the returned unit physically arrives at the depot, well after prediction time.

columns.name: depot_code
columns.reason: The receiving depot is assigned when the return is routed, though it may follow a fixed site mapping.

columns.name: asset_tag_prefix
columns.reason: Asset tagging is applied at deployment and is static thereafter.

columns.name: temp_max_c
columns.reason: Maximum in-service temperature comes from telemetry already logged before the claim.

columns.name: recycler_code
columns.reason: A recycler is only assigned at final disposition, which follows the approval decision.

columns.name: postmortem_reallocated_sectors
columns.reason: Postmortem measurement taken after teardown of the returned drive.

columns.name: cert_template
columns.reason: The erasure/destruction certificate is issued during return processing, after the claim.

columns.name: operator_shift
columns.reason: The shift of the operator who pulls the drive and raises the claim is known at filing.

columns.name: capacity_class
columns.reason: Static product attribute of the drive.

columns.name: vendor_triage_code
columns.reason: The vendor's triage verdict is produced after receiving the unit and drives the approval outcome.

columns.name: purchase_lot
columns.reason: Procurement lot is fixed at purchase and on file long before failure.

columns.name: audit_batch
columns.reason: Ambiguous: could be a procurement/QA audit grouping known upfront or a retrospective audit of closed RMAs.

columns.name: power_on_hours
columns.reason: SMART counter readable from the drive at the time the claim is raised.

columns.name: load_cycle_count
columns.reason: SMART counter accumulated in service and read before the claim.

columns.name: chassis_slot
columns.reason: Installed position is known from the fleet inventory record.

columns.name: pallet_id
columns.reason: A pallet is assigned only when the unit is staged for return shipment.

columns.name: packaging_spec
columns.reason: Recorded when the unit is actually packed for return, though it may follow a fixed model policy.

columns.name: fleet_group
columns.reason: Fleet grouping is standing inventory metadata.

columns.name: vendor_region
columns.reason: Vendor's servicing region is known from the supplier record at claim time.

columns.name: raid_level
columns.reason: Array configuration the drive was serving in is known before the pull.

columns.name: model_family
columns.reason: Static product attribute of the drive.

columns.name: label_printer
columns.reason: Identifies the printer that produced the return label, generated after the return is authorised.

columns.name: data_recovery_hours
columns.reason: Labour hours accrue while the returned drive is being worked, after prediction time.

columns.name: spin_retry_count
columns.reason: SMART counter read from the drive before the claim is filed.

columns.name: site_code
columns.reason: Data-centre site of the installed drive is static inventory metadata.

columns.name: shipment_batch
columns.reason: Return shipments are batched only after the claim is raised and the return authorised.

columns.name: rma_queue
columns.reason: The routing queue is assigned when the RMA request is created at intake, before adjudication.

columns.name: rack_row
columns.reason: Physical location in the data centre is static inventory metadata.

columns.name: disposition_office
columns.reason: Disposition handling is decided after the approval outcome is known.

columns.name: days_to_disposition
columns.reason: Elapsed time to a post-decision event, definitionally unknown at prediction time.
